om: Bildplanen för Matstrumpors mejl: ett eget motiv per mejl i stället för samma sushibild i alla (Axels dom 2026-09-29: "det är bara samma bild i alla mejl, och ingen vill riktigt se det där. Så alla kommer unsubscribea"). Nya bilder görs med kie.ai (google/nano-banana-edit) med butikens riktiga produktfoton som referens, så att lådorna ser ut som de gör; befintliga bilder är butikens egna livsstilsbilder i Shopify Files. Motorn: node klaviyo/mejlbilder.mjs --brand matstrumpor. Varje bild granskas av sessionen innan den godkänns: rätt produkt, ingen påhittad text, inga ansikten i nya bilder, inga konstiga händer eller fötter.

produkter.sushi-lada: the sushi sock gift box from the reference photo: a black plastic tray with a clear plastic lid holding socks rolled up to look exactly like sushi, two salmon nigiri (orange with thin white stripes), two tamago nigiri (yellow with a black band) and maki rolls with a black or red outside and white, green and orange centers, with strips of green plastic grass between them
produkter.sushi-tallrik: socks rolled up to look exactly like sushi, as in the reference photo: salmon nigiri (orange with thin white stripes), tamago nigiri (yellow with a black band) and maki rolls with a black or red outside and white, green and orange centers
produkter.sushi-strumpor: the sushi-pattern socks from the reference photo: orange socks with thin white diagonal stripes like salmon, and white socks with a black band and a green or yellow foot
produkter.pizza-lada: the pizza sock gift box from the reference photo: a white pizza box with green lettering, holding yellow socks printed with pizza toppings arranged in a circle to look like a whole pizza, with beige socks as the crust
produkter.pizza-strumpor: the yellow pizza socks from the reference photo, printed with pepperoni, tomato slices, olives and green herbs
produkter.burgare: the hamburger sock gift box from the reference photo: a white box printed with a black line drawing of a hamburger and a dark red lid, holding folded socks with a burger pattern (red socks with green lettuce and brown patty print)
produkter.donut: the donut sock gift box from the reference photo: a long pink box with a clear window, holding socks rolled into donut shapes, plus socks printed with chocolate, green and pink donut frosting and sprinkles

stil: Photorealistic lifestyle photograph, natural soft light, shallow depth of field, warm and inviting Scandinavian home style, high detail. The product must look exactly like in the reference photos: same colors, same patterns, same packaging. Do not add any text, letters, numbers, logos, labels or watermarks anywhere; only print that is already on the product packaging may appear. No human faces: people appear only as hands, arms, legs or feet.
